emptyState.heading: Install your first Godot editor
emptyState.description: Choose a version and build. You can install more versions later.

search.noResultsHint: No installed editor matches "{{query}}". Try a different version or clear your search.

messages.revalidationFailed: Validation failed. Check your storage device and try again.
messages.revalidationStillMissing: Validation finished but {{version}} is still unavailable. Confirm {{path}} is accessible before retrying.
messages.revalidationStillMissingNoPath: Validation finished but {{version}} is still unavailable. Confirm the storage device is mounted before retrying.
messages.unavailableHintWithReinstall: The editor path is not accessible. Mount the storage device and retry, reinstall the editor, or remove this entry.
messages.reinstallFailed: Reinstall failed. Check your connection and try again.
messages.unavailableCustomEditorHint: The custom editor path is not accessible. Mount the storage device and retry, or remove this entry.

replace.title: Replace custom editor?
replace.message: A custom editor with this version is already registered.
replace.detail: Replacing it will update the editor record in Godot Launcher to use the selected manifest. Your editor files will not be deleted.

drop.title: Drop manifest to add custom editor

creator.title: Create Custom Editor Manifest
creator.description: Create a manifest file for a custom Godot editor and register it immediately.

outputDirectory.label: Output folder
outputDirectory.help: Folder where godotlauncher-editor-manifest.json will be written.

name.label: Display name
name.help: Name shown in Godot Launcher for this custom editor.

version.label: Manifest version
version.help: Unique version identifier for this custom editor.

baseVersion.label: Base version
baseVersion.help: Godot compatibility version in major.minor format.

flavor.label: Flavor
flavor.help: Use gdscript for standard builds or dotnet for .NET builds. Custom values are allowed.

prerelease.label: Prerelease
prerelease.help: Mark this editor as a prerelease build.

platform.label: Platform
platform.help: Operating system this manifest entry supports.

arch.label: Architecture
arch.help: CPU architecture this editor supports. Universal works on any architecture for the selected platform.

editorPath.label: Editor path
editorPath.help: Path to the custom Godot editor executable or app bundle.

consolePath.label: Console path
consolePath.help: Optional path to a console executable for this editor.

baseVersion.baseVersion: Base version must use major.minor format, for example 4.4.

validation.createFailed: Failed to create custom editor manifest.

confirm.title: Remove selected editors
confirm.managed: Installed editor files will be deleted from your device. You can install them again later.
confirm.custom: Custom editors will be removed from Godot Launcher. Their files will be kept.
confirm.used: Projects using this editor: {{names}}. They will need another editor.

errors.busy: This editor is being installed or removed. Try again when it finishes.
errors.changed: This editor changed since it was selected. Select it again.
errors.used: This editor is in use or is externally managed. It was kept.
errors.failed: Could not remove the selected editors. Try again.

commandLine.title: Default command-line Godot
commandLine.tooltip: Default command-line Godot. Used when you type godot in a terminal. Uses this editor's normal preferences, independently of Godot Launcher's per-project preferences.
commandLine.explanation: Run {{name}} by typing godot in your terminal. To use the editor themes, shortcuts and other settings saved separately for each project, open projects from Godot Launcher.
commandLine.enabled: godot now uses {{name}}. Restart your terminal to use the command.
commandLine.cleared: The godot command created by Godot Launcher has been removed. PATH setup has been kept for future use.
commandLine.conflict: Another godot command takes precedence: {{command}}. Your existing command and PATH order have been kept. Resolve this conflict in your shell configuration to use the selected editor.
commandLine.removalWarning: This editor is your default command-line Godot. Removing it will also remove the godot command created by Godot Launcher.

settings.description: Use this version when you run godot in a terminal.
settings.selected: {{name}} is now the default godot command.
settings.loadError: Could not check the default command.

aliases.title: Named alias
aliases.description: Run this version using its own terminal command.
aliases.name: Command name
aliases.error: Could not check availability. Try again.
aliases.pathChanged: Open a new terminal to use the command.
aliases.explanation: Run {{name}} by typing {{command}} in your terminal. To use the editor themes, shortcuts and other settings saved separately for each project, open projects from Godot Launcher.
aliases.discardMessage: Your alias changes have not been applied.

errors.invalid: Use 1-48 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
errors.reserved: This command name is reserved. Choose another.
errors.taken: Already used by {{name}}. Choose another name.
errors.external: This name is already used by another command or file. Choose another.
errors.unavailable: This editor is unavailable. Check the installation and try again.
errors.recovery: This alias needs recovery. Retry after resolving the file or installation problem.
errors.renameRecovery: The rename from {{previous}} to {{name}} is unfinished. Both names stay reserved until recovery completes. Resolve the file or installation problem, then retry.

aliases.removeExplanation: Remove {{command}} from your terminal commands? The installed editor and your default godot command will stay unchanged.
